knowledge:
- key_parameters: positionType=Specifies whether the positioning is "trajectory" or "spatial" ;; positionColData=Column name(s) in colData containing pseudotime or spatial coordinates ;; span=Proportion of cells with non-zero weights around a central cell (default 0.25) ;; nrow.out=Number of rows to thin the weight matrix to for faster runtimes ;; higherOrderFunction=Function to calculate higher order structure (e.g., matrixStats::weightedVar or weightedSpearman) ;; higherOrderFunctionType=Type of higher order function (e.g., "weighted") ;; higherOrderSummaryFunction=Summary function of the local higher order sequence (default sd) ;; numberPermutations=Number of permutations for permutation testing ;; nperm_estimate=Maximum number of permutations to use for estimating p-values ;; maxDist=Maximum difference in global higher order function to borrow permutations for p-value estimation
- alternatives: None mentioned
- when_to_use: Use when you want to test if gene expression variability or gene-gene correlation changes dynamically along a continuous trajectory (like pseudotime) or across spatial coordinates in spatial transcriptomics data.
- pitfalls: Setting numberPermutations too low can result in p-values of zero; use scHOT_estimatePvalues to borrow permutations and estimate more accurate p-values. Thinning the weight matrix using nrow.out speeds up computation but means not every position is sampled, which affects the resolution of plotHigherOrderSequence. If the permutation distribution plot is bumpy, select more genes and increase the number of permutations.

workflows.name: trajectory_variability_testing
workflows.intent: Test for changes in single-gene expression variability along a developmental trajectory.
workflows.stages: 1. Build scHOT object from matrix using scHOT_buildFromMatrix ;; 2. Add testing scaffold using scHOT_addTestingScaffold ;; 3. Set weight matrix using scHOT_setWeightMatrix ;; 4. Calculate global higher order function using scHOT_calculateGlobalHigherOrderFunction ;; 5. Set permutation scaffold using scHOT_setPermutationScaffold ;; 6. Calculate higher order test statistics using scHOT_calculateHigherOrderTestStatistics ;; 7. Perform permutation test using scHOT_performPermutationTest ;; 8. Estimate p-values using scHOT_estimatePvalues ;; 9. Plot results using plotHigherOrderSequence
workflows.code:
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_buildFromMatrix(
  mat = liver_branch_hep[,first_branch_cells],
  cellData = list(pseudotime = liver_pseudotime_hep[first_branch_cells]),
  positionType = "trajectory",
  positionColData = "pseudotime")
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_addTestingScaffold(scHOT_traj, gene_to_test)
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_setWeightMatrix(scHOT_traj,
                                    positionType = "trajectory",
                                    positionColData = c("pseudotime"),
                                    nrow.out = 50,
                                    span = 0.25)
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_calculateGlobalHigherOrderFunction(
  scHOT_traj, 
  higherOrderFunction = matrixStats::weightedVar,
  higherOrderFunctionType = "weighted")
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_setPermutationScaffold(scHOT_traj, 
                                           numberPermutations = c(20,50,20),
                                           storePermutations = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE))
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_calculateHigherOrderTestStatistics(
  scHOT_traj,
  higherOrderSummaryFunction = sd)
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_performPermutationTest(
  scHOT_traj, 
  verbose = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE)
scHOT_traj <- scHOT_estimatePvalues(scHOT_traj,
                                    nperm_estimate = 10000,
                                    maxDist = 5)
plotHigherOrderSequence(scHOT_traj, gene_to_test)

workflows.name: spatial_differential_correlation
workflows.intent: Test for spatial differential correlation between pairs of genes across spatial coordinates.
input: spatial_sce.rds (SingleCellExperiment object containing logcounts assay and spatial coordinates x and y in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Build scHOT object from SingleCellExperiment using scHOT_buildFromSCE ;; 2. Add gene pairs to testing scaffold using scHOT_addTestingScaffold ;; 3. Run the wrapper function scHOT to perform weight matrix setup, global function calculation, permutation testing, and test statistic calculation ;; 4. Estimate p-values using scHOT_estimatePvalues ;; 5. Plot results using plotOrderedExpression and plotHigherOrderSequence
workflows.code:
scHOT_spatial <- scHOT_buildFromSCE(sce_MOB_subset,
                                    assayName = "logcounts",
                                    positionType = "spatial",
                                    positionColData = c("x", "y"))
scHOT_spatial <- scHOT_addTestingScaffold(scHOT_spatial, pairs)
scHOT_spatial <- scHOT(scHOT_spatial,
                       testingScaffold = pairs,
                       positionType = "spatial",
                       positionColData = c("x", "y"),
                       nrow.out = NULL,
                       higherOrderFunction = weightedSpearman,
                       higherOrderFunctionType = "weighted",
                       numberPermutations = 50,
                       numberScaffold = 10,
                       higherOrderSummaryFunction = sd,
                       parallel = FALSE,
                       verbose = FALSE,
                       span = 0.05)
scHOT_spatial <- scHOT_estimatePvalues(scHOT_spatial,
                                       nperm_estimate = 100,
                                       maxDist = 0.1)
plotOrderedExpression(scHOT_spatial, c("Arrb1", "Mtor"),
                      positionColData = c("-x", "y"),
                      assayName = "expression")
plotHigherOrderSequence(scHOT_spatial, "Arrb1_Mtor",
                        positionColData = c("-x", "y"))
